description: Grid: task folders, a planner per task, the Feed and the brain, all written through one grid command.
name: grid

shared_group.description: Only when several logins on this computer share one Grid machine folder: the group they share. Leave empty to keep the folder private. grid setup --shared-group <group> writes it to the Grid config and prints the commands a person runs to make the folder; Grid runs no sudo.
shared_group.title: Shared group
